capabilities.text: Strict access controls for viewing/editing notes
capabilities.quote: Yes, we’ll need strict access controls—only nurses on the same ward and their team leaders can view or edit notes.

capabilities.text: Encrypt data at rest and in transit
capabilities.quote: All data must be encrypted at rest and in transit

capabilities.text: Comply with HIPAA
capabilities.quote: and we’ll comply with HIPAA and the hospital group’s data governance policy.

capabilities.text: Comply with hospital group's data governance policy
capabilities.quote: and we’ll comply with HIPAA and the hospital group’s data governance policy.

capabilities.text: Use AWS for hosting
capabilities.quote: but I’ll go with AWS since it’s the one our IT team already uses for other systems.

capabilities.text: Connect to Electronic Patient Record (EPR) system
capabilities.quote: The tool needs to connect to our current electronic patient record (EPR) system, called Epic

capabilities.text: Pull patient name, MRN, and current bed number from Epic
capabilities.quote: We’ll need to pull the patient’s name, MRN, and current bed number from Epic

capabilities.text: Connect to ward's daily handover spreadsheet on SharePoint
capabilities.quote: and the ward’s daily handover spreadsheet, which is stored in a shared SharePoint folder.

capabilities.text: Push final note into SharePoint file once a day
capabilities.quote: and push the final note into the SharePoint file once a day.

capabilities.text: Use low-code tools for development
capabilities.quote: I’ll ask them to use low-code tools if possible to speed up delivery.

capabilities.text: Add new rows to SharePoint handover file daily
capabilities.quote: Got it, new rows will be added each day.

capabilities.text: Use Power Apps as main development platform
capabilities.quote: I’d prefer to go with that as the main development platform—it’ll let us build the note entry form quickly

capabilities.text: Use Power Automate for connections
capabilities.quote: Power Apps for the form, Power Automate for the connections to Epic and SharePoint

capabilities.text: Structured fields for vitals, medications, and key observations
capabilities.quote: I’d prefer structured fields—nurses already enter vitals, medications, and key observations in the handover sheet, so we should capture those consistently.

capabilities.text: Form includes fields for blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, pain score, and new medications
capabilities.quote: The form will include fields for blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, pain score, and any new medications, with dropdowns or numeric inputs where possible.

capabilities.text: Allow free text at the end of the note
capabilities.quote: Nurses can still add free text at the end for context

capabilities.text: Version one in use by end of next quarter (September 30)
capabilities.quote: We need version one on a pilot ward by the end of next quarter—around September 30.

capabilities.text: Budget under £20,000
capabilities.quote: but I’ll aim for under £20,000 to keep it within the innovation unit’s annual allocation.

capabilities.text: Track hours spent and additional costs
capabilities.quote: I’ll make sure the team tracks every hour spent and any additional costs, like training materials or support time

capabilities.text: Flag budget at 80% of limit
capabilities.quote: If we hit 80% of the limit, I’ll flag it immediately and review what’s essential for the pilot.

capabilities.text: Log every note creation or edit
capabilities.quote: But I do want to make sure the tool logs every time a note is created or edited, and who did it

capabilities.text: Store audit logs separately from note data
capabilities.quote: I’ll also make sure the audit logs are stored separately from the note data

capabilities.text: Retain audit logs for at least seven years
capabilities.quote: The logs will include the nurse’s ID, timestamp, and action type—like “created” or “edited”—and will be retained for at least seven years

capabilities.text: Confirm Epic connection method before build
capabilities.quote: my IT team will confirm the connection method before we start building.
